title: StablecoinX ENA Lock-Up Waiver Review: Sales, Consent & mNAV
headline: Can StablecoinX sell its ENA now that the lock-ups are gone?
name: StablecoinX lock-up waiver review
description: StablecoinX's ENA lock-ups ended on October 5, 2026, but each sale still needs Ethena Foundation consent. The signed terms and the dashboard effect.
imageAlt: ENA bought under StablecoinX's two token purchase agreements and still locked, on the old 48-month schedule and with the October 5, 2026 waiver, which took the count from 1.56 billion to zero
